notes.title: 2023 has a new worst PC game of the year
notes.notes:
2023 has been quite the year for gaming. We've seen highs like Starfield, Baldur's Gate 3, and Diablo 4, and success stories for indie games like Sea of Stars and Dave the Diver. We've seen some absolute flops too, though: Redfall and Lord of the Rings: Gollum, I'm looking at you. As we delve deeper into spooky season and winter approaches, I didn't think there was any room for more bottom-tier games, but Skull Island: Rise of Kong might just have snatched the last place crown.
